purpose: Reference inventory of providers listed by Apple for the Weather app, plus a separately identified WeatherKit integration. This is not an authorization, endpoint catalog, service-health assertion, or proof of direct API access.

authoritativeReferences.title: Apple Weather feature availability and data sources

integrationRules: Apple's Weather app source list is attribution context only; do not infer that each provider offers TSM direct API access.
Verify API terms, authentication, quotas, geographic coverage, retention, redistribution, attribution, and commercial-use rights independently before enabling ingestion.
Record provenance at the data-product level, not only at provider level.
WeatherKit is a separate optional integration; it does not replace direct NOAA/NWS or other national-authority feeds.
Never label a provider operational until endpoint behavior and current data freshness have been tested.
